name: Hirano Touko
source:
A capable woman who is devoted to her work. She was originally McCoy's secretary, but was ordered by him to become Juri's secretary. It is unknown what she thinks inside, but she seems to get along well with Juri and does her job well.

　 Among Juri's team, which is full of eccentrics, she is the one who is closest to sensible, but this doesn't really act as a brake.

　 Although she has a fairly harsh personality at work, she can be surprisingly gentle in her private life. At first she is amazed at how Juri's team mixes business with personal life, but gradually she comes to enjoy it.
  "Walking down the streets at night together like this... isn't so bad.

Even I think it's a bit poisonous, though."
